```{r, fig.width = 10}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

setwd("/nfs/home/students/t.tabanli/artifical_meat_deconv/counts_cattle_atlas")

cattle <- readRDS("sampled_cattle_atlas.RDS")
cattle$cell_type <- trimws(cattle$cell_type)
cattle$cell_type <- gsub("'", "", cattle$cell_type) # Henle's loop causes issues in column parse
cattle$cell_type <- gsub("/", "_", cattle$cell_type)
dim(cattle)
length(unique(cattle$cell_type))

cattle <- NormalizeData(cattle)
cattle <- FindVariableFeatures(cattle)
cattle <- ScaleData(cattle)
cattle <- RunPCA(cattle)
cattle <- RunUMAP(cattle, dims = 1:30)
DimPlot(cattle, group.by = "cell_lineage", pt.size = 0.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(pals::alphabet(n_distinct(cattle$cell_lineage))),
                     name = "Cell lineage") +
  labs(title = "Cattle Atlas", x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")
ggsave("figures/cattleatlas_umap_cell_lineage.png", width = 9)
```

```{r, fig.width = 30, fig.height = 10}
highlight <- c("Fibroblasts", "Mesenchymal stem cells", "Myofibroblasts", "Skeletal muscle cells")
table(paste0(cattle$cell_type)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(cell_type = "Var1") %>%
  mutate(highlighted = cell_type %in% highlight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cell_type, y = Freq, fill = highlighted, color = highlighted)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "white", "TRUE" = "lightblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "darkgray", "TRUE" = "lightblue")) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "black", angle = 90) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust=0, size = 11),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave("distro_cell_types.png", width = 30, height = 10)
```

# Cell Ontology Remapping

```{r, fig.width = 20}
library(ontologyIndex)

selected_ct_ids <- readLines("selected_classes.txt")
ct_to_cl <- read_csv("celltype_to_CL_map.csv")
onto <- get_OBO("cl-basic.obo")

# returns: data.frame with columns:
# - old_id | original cell ontology ID
# - new_id | the cell ontology ID from the selected IDs that the old id maps to
map_to_selected <- function(cell_onto_ids, ontology, selected_ids) {
  # rows are the ancestors, cols are our annotation terms
  desc_matrix <- get_term_descendancy_matrix(ontology, terms = cell_onto_ids, rows = selected_ids)
  df_list <- lapply(colnames(desc_matrix), function(old_id) {
    #cat(old_id, "\n")
    new_id <- NULL
    if (old_id %in% selected_ids) new_id <- old_id
    else {
      new_id <- rownames(desc_matrix)[which(desc_matrix[,old_id])] # multiple is possible
    }
    
    # if the query term's ancestor not found in the selected terms, skip!
    if (length(new_id) == 0) return()
      
    # if maps to multiple ancestors from the selected
    # preserve the original id
    if (length(new_id) > 1) new_id <- old_id
    result <- data.frame(old_id = old_id, old_name = ontologyIndex::get_term_property(onto, "name", term = old_id),
                         new_id = new_id, new_name = sapply(new_id, function(one_id) ontologyIndex::get_term_property(onto, "name", term = one_id), USE.NAMES = F))
    return(result)
  })
  
  return(bind_rows(df_list))
}

ids_to_map <- ct_to_cl$cl_id[!is.na(ct_to_cl$cl_id)]
cl_to_coarse <- map_to_selected(cell_onto_ids = ids_to_map,
                                ontology = onto,
                                selected_ids = selected_ct_ids)

converter <- ct_to_cl %>%
  dplyr::select(-notes) %>%
  full_join(cl_to_coarse, by = join_by("cl_id" == "old_id")) %>%
  mutate(new_name = case_when(original == "Unknown cells" ~ "Unknown cells",
                              is.na(new_name) ~ "ignored",
                              .default = new_name))

cattle$coarse_type <- dplyr::recode_values(cattle$cell_type, from = converter$original, to = converter$new_name)
saveRDS(cattle, file = "sampled_cattle_atlas.RDS")
write.csv(cattle@meta.data, "sampled_cattle_atlas/metadata.csv")


umap_colors <- DiscretePalette(n_distinct(cattle$coarse_type))
names(umap_colors) <- unique(cattle$coarse_type)
umap_colors[is.na(names(umap_colors))] <- "beige"
ignore_cells <- unique(converter$cl_name[converter$new_name == "ignored"])
DimPlot(cattle, group.by = "coarse_type", cols = umap_colors) +
  ggplot2::labs(caption = paste0("Cells ignored: ", paste0(ignore_cells, collapse=", "), "; n = ", sum(cattle$coarse_type == "ignored"),
                                 "\nUnknown cells are propagated from the original annotation. Unknown cell types of the original meta data were replaced with the label field.\nThe cell types are manually matched against cell ontology classes, and gathered in coarse classes seen in the legend."))

highlight <- c("cell of skeletal muscle", "stromal cell")
table(paste0(cattle$coarse_type)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(highlighted = Var1 %in% highlight) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = highlighted, color = highlighted)) + geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "black", angle = 90) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "white", "TRUE" = "lightblue")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "darkgray", "TRUE" = "lightblue")) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust=0, size = 11),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")
```

source("~/artifical_meat_deconv/toolkit.R")

comp_adipo_dwls <- readRDS("sig_dwls_lineage/adipo_compositions_cattleatlas_dwls_signature.Rds")

comp_adipo_scaden <- readRDS("sig_scaden_lineage/adipo_compositions_cattleatlas_scaden.Rds")

comp_myo_dwls <- readRDS("sig_dwls_lineage/myo_compositions_cattleatlas_dwls_signature.Rds")
comp_myo_dwls <- comp_myo_dwls[rownames(comp_myo_dwls) != "", ]
mode(comp_myo_dwls) <- "numeric"
comp_myo_rectangle <- read_csv("sig_rectangle_lineage/rectangle_estimations_myo.csv") %>%
  column_to_rownames("index") %>% as.matrix()
rownames(comp_myo_rectangle) <- gsub(".*_", "", rownames(comp_myo_rectangle))
comp_myo_scaden <- readRDS("sig_scaden_lineage/myo_compositions_cattleatlas_scaden.Rds")

```{r}
bulk_meta_adipo <- read_csv('/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/adipogenesis/sample_sheet_cleaned.csv', col_names = T) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()
bulk_meta_myo <- read_csv('/nfs/data2/huji_artificial_meat/myogenesis/sample_sheet_cleaned.csv', col_names = T) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

bulk_meta_adipo <- bulk_meta_adipo %>%
  select(library_name, sample_id, title, group, bio_replicate, individual, treatment, day) %>%
  mutate(day = recode(day, "D3" = "D2")) %>%
  mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("D0", "D2", "D3", "D6", "D14")))
bulk_meta_myo <- bulk_meta_myo %>%
  select(library_name, sample_id, group, day, bio_replicate, treatment) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = gsub(".*_", "", sample_id)) %>%
  mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d0", "d3", "d7", "d21")),
         group = gsub("(?!Sat)D\\d*", "\\", group, perl = T)) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(cols = group, delim = "_", names = c(NA, "group"), too_few = "align_end")

# dwls rownames are canonical (come from actual bulk matrix)
sxx_correct <- setNames(rownames(comp_myo_dwls), gsub(".*_", "", rownames(comp_myo_dwls)))
# fix meta
bulk_meta_myo$sample_id <- sxx_correct[gsub(".*_", "", bulk_meta_myo$sample_id)]
# fix scaden (currently has meta's wrong names)
rownames(comp_myo_scaden) <- sxx_correct[gsub(".*_", "", rownames(comp_myo_scaden))]
```

## Adipo compositions
```{r, fig.width=15}
adipo_merged <- merge_methods(comp_adipo_dwls, comp_adipo_rectangle, comp_adipo_scaden,
                              meta = bulk_meta_adipo, method_names = c("dwls", "rectangle", "scaden"))

sig_cell_types <- adipo_merged %>%
  filter(proportion > 0.0) %>%
  pull(cell_type) %>% unique()

df_adipo_plot <- adipo_merged %>%
  mutate(cell_type = ifelse(cell_type %in% sig_cell_types, cell_type, "Other (< 5%)")) %>%
  group_by(across(-proportion)) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion), .groups = "drop")

sig_names  <- sort(setdiff(unique(df_adipo_plot$cell_type), "Other (< 5%)"))
color_vals <- c(setNames(unname(pals::alphabet(length(sig_names))), sig_names),
                "Other (< 5%)" = "gray70")
color_vals["Unknown"] <- "white"

p <- df_adipo_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample_id, y = proportion, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col(linewidth = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(day + individual ~ method, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_vals, name = "Cell type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Proportion", x = NULL) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.right = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.border       = element_rect(color = "gray70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing.y    = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )
p
```

sig_names  <- sort(setdiff(unique(df_adipo_plot$cell_type), "Other (< 5%)"))
color_vals <- c(setNames(unname(pals::alphabet(length(sig_names))), sig_names),
                "Other (< 5%)" = "gray70")

sat_samples <- df_myo_plot %>% filter(group == "Sat")
others <- df_myo_plot %>% filter(group != "Sat")

p <- ggplot(others, aes(x = paste0(sample_id, "_", group), y = proportion, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Sample", y = "Proportion") +
  facet_grid(day ~ method, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_vals, name = "Cell type") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    ncol          = 1,
    keyheight     = unit(1, "lines"),
    keywidth      = unit(1, "lines"),
    label.theme   = element_text(size = 8),
    override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2)
  ))
p
